description: Traffic Counts at Signalized Intersections (2011 - 2020) is a dataset listed in City of Salinas Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Salinas, Public Works Department, GIS Division. This data shows traffic counts approaching and occurring at signalized intersections within the City of Salinas, Monterey County, California primarily prior to 2018. Disclaimer & Warranties/Accuracy: GIS data in this map are provided as an information resource for the public use and are provided "AS IS" without warranties of any kind, expressed or implied. Coverage: Salinas, California. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Signalized Intersections, Traffic Signals, Traffic Counts, Intersections, Feature Service, Transportation and Infrastructure. The portal shows 140 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityofsalinas-portal.
